string.text: Tada! Sabrina here, ready to conduct "culinary research"! If I help the Commander with the promo... could I maybe... you know, skip the bill?
SPAS-12? Good to see you again!
Hello, this is Sabrina 12! Nice to see you again!
What's this elmochan notification on my PDA...?
Commander, I've uploaded a new food video- it's about making mustard apple pie. Don't forget to give me a like!
Sabrina, enough for today. Please head back to base.
